    count1++;
    for (int digit = 0; digit <= 9; ++digit) {

}

            answer = (answer + (s[i] + p * v[i].size() - mod1 * (v[i].size() - w))) % mod2;

    for (int i = (level == 0 ? 1 : 0); i <= 9; ++i) {
        explore(level + 1, current * 10 + i);

    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
